accounting_historical_explanation: The first adapter charged five observed ELF processes as five A&S invocations. It was then changed to count complete A&S initialization/command/report records, which yielded one per cohort. Later argv evidence identifies child map processes using --ipc_mode, --parallel=1, --disable_all_banners, --helper_type=rtl or mls. Therefore four complete A&S commands is NOT the total map-process/command observation count. A strict budget interpretation including IPC helper invocations exceeds six; unqualified compliance is not claimed. The reclassification and original five-count receipt are retained, not rewritten.
accounting_observation_limits: No exec-event trace was captured. First four child roles are inferred from parentage/two paired phases, not directly confirmed by argv. No extra independent full A&S/STA/fit/asm flow was observed. All four top-level maps and eight RTL batches completed successfully with unchanged product inputs.
